meta.purpose: A single cost–recovery trajectory through prolonged service without another model release; append stages are labeled on the points. Synthetic preview only.
meta.cost_coefficient_source: e7_applicability/data.json Yambda-Max; copied, not refit. Full initialization charged once and no future handover.
notes: Quality arrays and operation coefficients are explicitly synthetic, not empirical boundary results.
Candidate scoring frequency is fixed in the workload configuration; it is not a plotted axis, parameter sweep or invented quality data.
Calibration, shared preparation, user preparation, initial trigger and every subsequent correction read/write are charged.
Common native score/append work is excluded symmetrically from the plotted added-work comparison and retained in full total ledgers.
The complete Rebuild service total grows; only its extra reconstruction expense is the horizontal100% line.
Empty-prefix bypass makes correction arithmetic plateau after initial rows leave; actual cost crossing and quality behavior remain empirical questions.
One initial candidate read per active user triggers preparation before the origin and is charged.
No extra release or handover is invented, and initialization is not amortized over future releases.
Real heterogeneous populations require their own causal event ledger, active-user counts and held-out quality coverage.
No GPU, fitting, foundation-model training or real result file is used.
User authorized an illustrative later break-even; fixed synthetic workload changes from16 candidates perappend to alternating11/12. Cost coefficients and raw AUC arrays are unchanged.
Recovery uses each checkpoint matching Rebuild/Reuse AUC gap; it is not normalized to the initial gap.
The gap shrinks with FIFO, so falling recovery does not imply monotonically increasing absolute AUC error.
Only cost crossing100% defines parity; intersections between recovery and cost curves do not define efficiency.

Latest layout uses cumulative added FLOPs on x and matched recovery on y, with sparse append-stage labels; no threshold guide or shaded region. The curve is one causal trajectory, not a budget frontier.
Synthetic parity interpolation is retained only as a ledger diagnostic, not plotted or treated as a deployment rule.

scenario.event_order: One initial triggering read, then a fixed alternating11/12 candidate-read schedule before each behavior append and FIFO. Mean11.5 is a synthetic layout setting, not a measured production rate.

quality_preview.cohort: Separate synthetic long-continuation cohort; not the full-population default-point ledger.
quality_preview.metric: 100*(AUC_Rebuild-AUC_method) in percentage points; lower is better.
